mapper.sql: select e.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, e.kb_space_quota, e.kb_space_used, e.kb_space_include_kb_ids, e.has_knowledge_base, e.kb_likes_ids, e.is_super, e.is_open_account_perm, e.is_open_module_perm from sys_user_extend e LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON e.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user_extend (user_id, kb_space_quota, kb_space_used, is_super, is_open_account_perm, is_open_module_perm) values (#{userId}, 1024, 0, 0, 0, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = user_id
